subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM thread opt-in behavior be modeled through the existing `replyToMode` threading contract or as a separate documented `dmThreadMode` account key?
rationale: The code change is small, but the permanent public config shape and the decision to re-enable DM thread targets after the prior invalid-resource fix require maintainer API and delivery-policy intent.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Threading Config
options.body: Use `replyToMode` or a deliberate extension of it for this opt-in, then update the schema, exported type, generated metadata, docs, tests, and live proof together.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode`
options.body: Keep a separate Google Chat DM-specific key if maintainers want distinct semantics, but require the full config contract and real Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Pause Until API Proof
options.body: Defer the config decision until an inspectable Google Chat deployment proves threaded DM replies no longer hit invalid-resource failures.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Existing Threading Config
recommendation.body: Use `replyToMode` or a deliberate extension of it for this opt-in, then update the schema, exported type, generated metadata, docs, tests, and live proof together.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest recent history across the prior DM suppression fix, verification, and adjacent Google Chat thread support.
